brands.name: Robert August Surfboards
brands.short_description: Huntington Beach surfboards handcrafted in Orange County, California since 1974 by Endless Summer surfer Robert August.

models.name: What I Ride
models.description: Robert's favorite board, the 'What I Ride', is a board that maximizes your fun regardless of the conditions. It comes with 60/40 rails that make it responsive and fast yet forgiving. Along with the rail design it's signature tear drop concave under the nose, greatly enhances your nose riding. The combination of these features makes this our most versatile (and popular) board. We always try to have a few on the rack in our shop! Poly Construction Single Fin Box or 2 + 1 Fin Set Up Nose: 18 1/4" Width: 23 1/4" Tail: 15 1/4" Thickness: 3 1/4" *Most Dims shown are for 9'6" and will vary with length - up or down. Glass: 6+6 oz. top/single 6 oz. bottom / Standard Tail Patch Tail Block Optional Gloss & Polish Finish Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately, we recommend the RA Center Fin in 9.5" or 7.5"! (Depending on your fin setup) Custom board lead times are approx. 3-4 months. [powr-photo-gallery label="LB1"] Interested in trying a 'What I Ride'? Interested in trying one in Costa Rica?! models.name: Wingnut I Pro Model
models.description: Just like the board Wingnut rode in "The Endless Summer II", the 'Wingnut I' Pro Model has a pulled in tail with softer rails, which result in ultra-smooth turns and cutbacks, along with improved control and stability. The wide point sits further up on the board giving the nose more surface area for nose riding, even with the pointed nose. Video below shows Wingnut riding both the Wingnut I and Wingnut II models in action. Designed as a single fin. Poly Construction 4-Stringer Option Included in Pricing Single Box Fin Set Up Nose: 17" Width: 22" Tail: 15" Thickness: 3" *Dims will vary with length Glassing: 6+6 oz. top/6 oz. bottom * Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately ~ we recommend the 9.0" Wingnut Cutaway!! Custom board production times are approx. 3-4 months. [powr-photo-gallery label="LB2"]

models.name: Wingnut II
models.description: The 'Wingnut II' Model takes the best qualities of the original 'Wingnut I' Pro Model and combines them with features from the 'Mark Martinson' Model. The tail is even more pulled in that the 'Wingnut I' and the rails are knifier, more like the 'Martinson'. This board is super fast and responsive and has amazing rail hold that makes it a great nose rider in the pocket . For a surfer who wants a single fin longboard that they can ride at a beach break or faster, punchier reefs or points, this board is perfect. Single Fin with Tail Block Standard. Video below shows Wingnut riding both the Wingnut I and Wingnut II models. FEATURES: Poly Construction Single Box Fin Set Up Nose: 17" Width: 22" Tail: 14" **Dims will vary with length** Glass: 6+6 oz. top/single 6 oz. bottom Stringer: 1/4" Darkwood (not shown) Layered Wood Tail Block Colorwork Shown: Clear Deck, Airspray: Bottom & Rails w/2 Red Pinlines Deck Gloss & Polish Finish * Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately, we recommend the 9.0" Wingnut Longrake!. Custom board production times are approx. 3-4 months. [powr-photo-gallery label="LB3"]

models.name: Wingnut Mini
models.description: The Wingnut 'Mini' is a shrunken down version of the 'Wingnut II' longboard. Super fast down the line and goes well in waves anywhere from knee high to over head. Great for turning and high line trimming but you can still sneak a cheater five in too! Poly Construction Single Box Fin Set up Nose: 17.5" Width: 22" Tail: 14.75" *Dims will vary with length Glassing: 6+6 oz. top/6 oz. bottom Stringer Config: Wood center w/black foam glue up each side Sand Finish Wood Tail Block Standard * Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately! Custom board lead times are approx. 3-4 months.

models.name: Saber
models.description: Our answer to high performance longboarding, the 'Saber' comes with low-egg rails that taper back to an edge at the diamond-tail. A slight rail-to-rail concave under the nose, with an overall flat bottom give this model some great turning capability to go along with solid nose riding. Works great in small to large waves and is super beach break friendly with a bit more rocker, it's lighter, and the narrow tail makes it easy to control in waves that tend to be steeper and more unpredictable. FEATURES: Poly Construction Box + Futures Fin Set up Nose: 18" Width: 23" Tail: 15" - Diamond Tail *Dims will vary with length Glassing: 6+6 oz. top/single 6 oz. bottom Shown with 3/4 - 6 oz Deck Patch Sand Finish * Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately. We recommend our 7.5" RA Center fin!! Custom board lead times are approx. 3-4 months.

models.name: Retro Longboard
models.description: The RA 'Retro' Model embodies our version of 'old school' log riding. Perfect for your SanO days, cruising and nose riding. Resin work with deck and tail patches give that old school look, weight and feel. Layered wood tail block and T-Band (3) Stringer configuration is standard for this classic shape. FEATURES: Poly Construction Single Box Fin Set Up Nose: 19" Width: 23" Tail: 16" **Dims will vary depending on length** Deck Patch: Knee, 1/2 or 3/4 Layered Wood Tail Block T-Band (3) Stringer Glassing: 8+8 oz. top/8 oz.bottom Sand Finish * Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately, we recommend our RA 'Retro' 10.0" by RFC! Custom board lead times are approx. 3-4 months.

models.name: Seed
models.description: When we introduced the 'Seed' model in 2014, it quickly became one of our favorite and most popular boards. It worked extremely well in clean punchy conditions as well as mushier days and it filled a perfect spot in our board lineup. Since the introduction, we have made a few functional tweaks to the design of this board while still keeping it true to the original concept. We started by making the nose and tail narrower, put in a standard 2+1 fin setup, and added a double concave to the bottom of the board to give it a loose lively feeling. The result is a super fast, super functional, and playful mid-length that's sure to up your wave count. You'll want to grab this board off your rack every day! Experience Level: Beginner to Expert Poly Construction 2+1 Fin Set up (side Futures included) Nose: 17.5" Width: 22" Tail: 15" *Dims will vary with length Multi layers 4 oz. glass top/single 6 oz. bottom 1/4" Dark Wood Stringer Round Tail Sand Only Finish * Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately. Custom board lead times are approximately 3 months.

models.name: Predator Stepdeck
models.description: The Mark Martinson ‘Step Deck’ aka ‘The Predator’, is everything great about the regular ‘Martinson’ model but with added features. The nose on the ‘Step Deck’ is thinned out making it lighter and giving it more flex. This feature enhances noseriding and turning ability significantly. This is a super versatile board in various conditions. It’s got a wide nose with a flat planing surface underneath that allows you to nose rid e with ease while still keeping your speed. One of the most functional and intuitive single fin longboards on the market. Single Fin Polyester Foam Construction Nose: 19 1/2" Wide: 24" Tail: 15" Thick: 3" Dims will vary depending on length Glassing: 6+6 oz. Deck / 6 oz. Bottom Standard Layered Wood Tail Block Gloss & Polish Finish ** Center fin is not included in pricing, but can be ordered separately. We recommend the RA 10" Flex Fin! Custom board lead times are approx. 3-4 months.

models.name: Martinson
models.description: Proven design concepts from the classic nose riding models of the 60′s blended with current surfboard design and production methodologies, results in a one-of-a-kind, classic. The wide nose utilizing a flat planning surface underneath, provides for the longest, tightest nose rides possible. Modern tail-rocker, light weight, and a custom single fin, allow this model to rip in any conditions. Hand Shaped Poly Construction Single Box Fin Set up Nose: 19" Width: 23.5 Tail: 15" *Dims will vary with length Glass: 6+6 oz. top/single 6 oz bottom, standard tail patch Wood Tail Block Standard Option for this Model * Please note: Center Fin is not included, can be ordered separately, w e suggest the RA 10" Flex fin!! Custom board lead times are 20+ weeks

models.name: FunDip
models.description: A perfect groveler board. It's got plenty of foam for easy paddling and tons of speed down the line. This thing just wants to go fast as soon as you stand up. Cruise over slow sections and drive through fast ones. Even with the step up in foam from your standard short board, you can still lay down a solid cutback or off the lip on this board. Once you get a taste of the fun dip, you might not be able to put it down. Futures quad set up, great for all wave sizes 2 ft and up! models.name: Endless Summer Replica
models.description: The Endless Summer 1963 ‘Replica’ Model. This limited edition board comes with a framed/numbered certificate of authenticity signed by Robert August. Available in 10’0” only.
